FROM-SCRATCH build (no shipped override existed; simSupported was false). Test-first re-derivation (scripts/tests/units/centi.test.ts, C1/C2/C-UNMODELED) — 7 assertions, all green. LINE DISPOSITIONS: (1) BURST 'Affects 5 enemy unit(s) with the lowest remaining HP. Deals 145.46% of final ATK as damage.' → burstCast → enemy flatDamage 145.46. burstCast-keyed (HER OWN Burst II cast, not fullBurstEnter); the nuke lands BEFORE the Full Burst window opens and never takes the +50% FB major (helm H7 / mica precedent). '5 lowest HP' collapses to ONE instance on the lone partless boss (anis / privaty-unkind-maid precedent). UNTAGGED for burstDesc: the 5-target selection clause is not an amp literal (owner ruling 2026-08-10). (2) BURST 'DEF ▼ 14.54% for 10 sec.' → burstCast → enemy defPct -14.54, durationSec 10. On the enemy DEF channel (bossDefNow scales cfg.bossDef by (1+Σ/100) at damage time — mica precedent). ~50% uptime (20s CD / 10s duration). The counterfactual (damageTakenPct laundering) is discriminated in the test. (3-7) All other lines UNMODELED verbatim — S1 battle-start force S2 (shield creation, offensively inert), S1 Full Charge → S2 CD ▼9.16% (CD reduction of offensively inert skill), S1 shield-destroyed heal (no shield-break model), S2 shield creation (shields don't affect damage dealt), Burst self Max HP ▲5% (no HP→ATK conversion for centi). S2b (claude-fable-5) cross-family review converged on burst nuke + DEF debuff encoding; diverged on shield/CD lines (fable: load-bearing for tandem shield consumers; driver ruling: inert at scope lock — no shield consumer exists on centi's own kit; a future tandem teammate would add its own consumer). EVIDENCE TIER: every magnitude is kit-text-literal (DATAMINED lvl-10): 145.46 / 14.54 / 10s. TIER 1: straightforward burst nuke + enemy DEF debuff; no scoped-buff, round-count, status-gate, or meta-defining mechanic. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-18.

skill1: Activates at the start of battle. Forcefully uses Skill 2. — shield creation at t=0; offensively inert (no DPS impact from shields in v1).
Activates when landing a Full Charge attack. Cooldown of Skill 2 ▼ 9.16%. — CD reduction of an offensively inert skill (S2 creates shields); no DPS channel.
Activates when the shield created by Centi is destroyed. Recovers 9.7% of the skill user's final Max HP as HP. — no shield-break model in v1; no shield entity to destroy.
skill2: Creates a Shield equal to 7% of the skill user's final Max HP for 5 sec. — shield creation; offensively inert in v1 (no HP pool modeled, no shielded consumer on centi's own kit).
burst: Max HP ▲ 5% for 10 sec. — self Max HP buff; offensively inert (no HP→ATK conversion for centi; would strengthen S2 shield basis but shield itself is inert).

caveats: burst: 'Affects 5 enemy unit(s) with the lowest remaining HP' collapses to ONE instance on the lone partless boss; no burstDesc tag (the 5-target selection is not an amp literal)
burst: DEF ▼ 14.54% is on the enemy DEF channel (defPct, mica precedent); ~50% uptime on 20s CD / 10s duration
